{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicates)}")
print(f"Patient IDs with duplicates: {list(duplicates.index)}")

# Check sample_seq for each duplicate patient
duplicate_rows = data[data['patient_id'].isin(duplicates.index)]
duplicate_rows_sorted = duplicate_rows.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'])

# Show the highest sample_seq for each duplicate patient
highest_sample_seq = duplicate_rows_sorted.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()

# Confirm that the highest sample_seq is unique per patient
highest_sample_seq_counts = highest_sample_seq.value_counts()
print(f"Highest sample_seq per patient: {highest_sample_seq_counts.to_dict()}")"}
